run_render: run the render function to generate RGB, depth, and segmentation buffers from a MuJoCo model and data
cast_ray: cast a ray against MuJoCo geometry using BVH traversal and return hit distance, normal, and barycentric coordinates
cast_ray_first_hit: cast a ray and return true on the first geometry hit within a maximum distance for shadow testing
sample_texture: sample a 2D texture at a UV coordinate computed from barycentric interpolation on a mesh face
compute_lighting: compute diffuse lighting contribution with optional shadow rays for directional, point, and spot lights
